title: What would undo the argument: solving the hard problem

statements.text: The case for idealism holds unless the hard problem is solved, that is, unless one explains what makes brains, made of the same stuff as the rest of the universe, uniquely accompanied by inner life.

sources.quote: unless we solve the “hard problem of consciousness” (Chalmers 2003) and explain what makes brains different from the inanimate universe as a whole in this regard
